title: Am I Blue or Is My Hobby Counting Teardrops? Expression Leakage in Large Language Models as a Symptom of Irrelevancy Disruption
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'expression leakage', which is defined as affective or stylistic drift (sentiment shifts) in LLM outputs. While it briefly mentions fairness and social/demographic biases as a broader context for LLM failure modes, the core research and evaluation are centered on sentiment analysis and semantic consistency, rather than religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
